source: Derived from immutable original frozen-source aggregation; no new scientific execution.

performance_gate.scope: Integration performance threshold; does not change validity of scientifically unsuccessful episodes or completed cohorts.

evidence_access.raw_evidence: Maintainer-local ignored paths only; no public evidence bundle configured.
evidence_access.model_assets: Maintainer-provided exact bytes required; no public accepted asset bundle configured.
evidence_access.path_base: repository root; these paths do not accompany an ordinary clone

limits: No causal attribution from a single seed per task; provider and device variation are recorded.
VLS and EDS have different actual compute budgets, reported separately; no equal-compute claim.
Live JSONL reads are prefixes and may observe a trailing incomplete line.
Method telemetry checks do not independently establish all descriptor geometry or executed tensor paths.

Task contract detail timestamps are regenerated; fresh task outcome/check summaries are compared semantically, while cached detail file hashes remain independently checked. Method detail canonical hashes must exactly match the fresh reconstruction.
No cross-chunk archive learning or recursive self-improvement is claimed.
measurement_notes: Worker elapsed seconds include online waits, simulation and local work; they are not active GPU hours.
Compute and service totals retain null when unknown in the source; transport HTTP attempt/retry totals are not inferred from logical CLI calls.
All 30 terminal videos passed complete CPU decode/frame-count checks; this does not establish semantic pixel or annotation correctness.

release_validation.skip_scope: Three external-staging-only before/after print-config comparisons; all three passed before patch application.
release_validation.source_snapshot_note: Original tested provenance is commit plus manifest/source snapshot. Two existing ignored Hydra aliases were later tracked with identical bytes in the code release.
